additional_info.subject: ID0394309-DC/Si-D/IL[Ly5YuF & nbXbmF] - Converter CRM:00315002168
additional_info.body:
Dear Orel, long time no see my friend :)
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R6 170002066
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
Ly5YuF & nbXbmF
Problem Description
: CanCommLoss and E:34
Troubleshooting
:
For the 170002066 you can order a new converter and replace it according to the E34 it needs replacement.
For the Y2 charger I can recommend ordering a new converter in case it needs replacement but we need to troubleshoot it. The error flag means that the CAN is not good, this can be either the cables or really the converter. My suggestion is to (before you replace anything), swap this converter that is missing with the neighbour one and see if the error is gone.
If the error is gone, then it might've been just a miscontact or similar.
If the error is still in the “faulty” converter after the swap then we can replace it.
If the error is now on the “working” converter then it's a problem with the CAN cables and possibly need replacement.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0394309
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
